# @kerfjs/ui

Accessible, production-backed UI primitives for kerf applications.

- [Package guide](./README.md)
- [AI skill](./ai/skill.md)
- [Component contract](./docs/component-contract.md)
- [Accessibility and keyboard contracts](./docs/accessibility.md)
- [Design philosophy](./docs/design-philosophy.md)
- [Apple HIG translation](./docs/apple-hig.md)
- [UX catalog](./docs/ux-demo.md)

Public components: `LucideIcon`, `Toolbar`, `ToolbarControlGroup`, `ToolbarText`, `MenuItem`, `MenuHeader`, `ResizableRegion`, `wireResizableRegions`, `AppTab`, `PageHeader`, `LoadingSpinner`, `Select`, `StateBanner`, `EmptyState`, `DialogHeader`, and `ValueTable`.

Only CSS and `@kerfjs/ui/select/register` have side effects. `kerfjs` is an external peer. The Web Awesome peer is optional and needed only for `Select` registration.
